title: Asparagus: Automated Synthesis of Parametric Gas Upper-Bounds for Smart Contracts
venue: ACM SIGPLAN Conference on Object-Oriented Programming, Systems, Languages, and Applications
abstract: Asparagus studies static resource analysis for smart contracts whose behavior can be represented by polynomial transition systems. It uses algebraic certificates, including Farkas’ lemma and related methods, to synthesize parametric upper bounds on gas consumption. The approach supports richer bounds than constant or purely linear estimates; its practical reach depends on the program model and the cost of solving the generated constraints.
summary: Automatically synthesizes gas upper bounds that depend on program inputs, using polynomial program models and sound algebraic reasoning.
